name: SIGINT
standfirst: Security research and practitioner news, scored for novelty and actionability.
colophon: sigint.wtf — the correct response to most of these CVEs. Scored by machine against a hand-written rubric; ranking is opinion, not fact.

items.title: CVE-2026-73570 — Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) OS Command Injection Vulnerability
items.dek: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS). Confirmed exploited in the wild. Federal remediation due 24 August.

items.title: Inadvertent Context Leakage in Language Models
items.dek: LLM context windows leak in-context secrets into benign outputs at 82–100% accuracy via adaptive black-box attacks; stronger models leak more.
items.unproven: Applicability to models with context filtering, reasoning chains, or production guardrails; remediation effectiveness; real-world exfiltration risk when agents hold live credentials.

items.title: CVE-2026-72529 — TrueConf Server Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
items.dek: TrueConf Server. Confirmed exploited in the wild. Federal remediation due 23 August.

items.title: CVE-2026-72530 — TrueConf Server Code Injection Vulnerability
items.dek: TrueConf Server. Confirmed exploited in the wild. Federal remediation due 3 September.

items.title: CauSec: Unboxing the Causal Drivers of Static Vulnerability Analysis Performance
items.dek: Causal framework exposes whether SAST design tradeoffs (speed, precision) actually deliver promised gains or rest on invalid assumptions.
items.unproven: evaluation scope and tool coverage not yet specified in abstract; needs full dataset and tool set details

items.title: CauSec: Unboxing the Causal Drivers of Static Vulnerability Analysis Performance
items.dek: CauSec causal framework tests whether SAST tool design assumptions (precision-detection tradeoffs) actually deliver claimed performance gains on real code.
items.unproven: framework applied to limited set of tools; generalization to reader's specific SAST portfolio and codebase composition undemonstrated

items.title: CVE-2026-64849 — MLflow Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
items.dek: MLflow MLflow. Confirmed exploited in the wild. Federal remediation due 2 September.

items.title: Task-Conditioned Least-Privilege Learning for Executable Terminal and MCP Agents
items.dek: Post-training framework teaches 4B LLM agents task-conditioned least-privilege, reducing excess-authority errors from 35.6% to 1.5%.
items.unproven: Evaluated on simulated terminal and MCP environments; no data on real SDLC agent deployments or agent-to-human behavior drift.

items.title: Supply Chain Attack on Arrayref
items.dek: Supply chain attack on Rust arrayref crate demonstrates real dependency risk; review SCA tool coverage of transitive Rust deps.
items.unproven: scope of affected versions and downstream impact not fully quantified from submission

items.title: Aray: Deterministic-First Synthesis of Benign Artifacts for YARA Validation
items.authors: Emanuel C. A. Valente et al.
items.dek: Aray synthesizes benign YARA test fixtures from rules without embedding malware, enabling reproducible validation of 182 of 416 public rules deterministically.
items.unproven: validation limited to public YARA rules; applicability to reader's proprietary rules and CI/CD workflows not established; model-assisted path relies on LLM without error bounds

items.title: Beyond the Transcript: Detecting Covert Co ordination in Latent Multi-Agent Communication
items.dek: Framework detects covert coordination in multi-agent LLM systems via latent-state monitoring and achieves 0.993 AUROC on homogeneous pairs.
items.unproven: whether real deployed multi-agent systems exhibit such coordination; scalability beyond the auction benchmark; robustness to agent obfuscation.

items.title: A single design choice determines whether machine learning models of materials make physically impossible predictions
items.dek: Parity labeling in neural material models determines whether physically impossible piezoelectric predictions occur; six orders of magnitude effect.
items.unproven: generalization beyond centrosymmetric crystals and piezoelectric constraints to other materials and properties used in cryptographic hardware

items.title: CTIFoundry: An Agent-Native Corpus Scaffold for Cyber Threat Intelligence
items.dek: Agent-native corpus scaffold for CTI materializes CVE/CWE/CAPEC/ATT&CK ontology and report structure for agentic investigation.
items.unproven: evaluation on CTIConnect benchmark only; readiness for production threat intelligence workflows and integration with reader's tools unclear

items.title: MaliciousSkillBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Malicious Agent Skill Detection
items.dek: Consolidated dataset of 7,539 unique malicious agent skills and 2,235 benign across 4,588 families; learned detectors achieve 0.882–0.932 macro-F1.
items.unproven: Generalization to skills not in the 13 source repositories; false-positive rates in production scanning; skill obfuscation resistance; maintenance lag as new skills emerge.

items.title: AEGIS: Attention-Embedding Gradient Isolation Shield - Triple-Channel Gradient Masking for Privacy-Preserving Federated LLM Fine-Tuning
items.dek: AEGIS closes three gradient inversion attack channels in federated LLM fine-tuning via attention freezing and calibrated noise without architectural changes.
items.unproven: Robustness to adaptive attacks aware of defense; model utility degradation on downstream tasks; computational overhead; comparison with differential privacy; real federated training validation.

items.title: HARP: Hierarchical Adaptive Ranking with Preference-Adaptive Fusion for Query-Based CVE Prioritization
items.dek: LLM-based CVE ranker learns preference scenarios from historical cases rather than explicit policy; outperforms fixed-criterion baselines.
items.unproven: tested on three scenarios only; generalization to reader's organization's triage patterns and preference drift over time undemonstrated; no production deployment data

items.title: From Threat Intelligence to Detection: Knowledge-driven Enrichment and Template-based Rule Grounding for Automated Sigma Rule Generation
items.dek: AUTOSIGMA automatically generates platform-independent Sigma rules from unstructured threat intelligence using knowledge-base enrichment.
items.unproven: accuracy of rule grounding on real APT reports; false-positive rates when deployed in production SIEMs; maintenance burden of the knowledge base.

items.title: Catastrophic Learning: A New Attack Vector on Continual Learning Networks
items.dek: Learning blockers attack continual-learning plasticity by poisoning data to reduce learnability in current or future iterations.
items.unproven: whether continual-learning models are in production use in security-critical contexts; defense mechanisms; real-world threat model validation.

items.title: Who Can Make the Action Happen? An Authority-Decomposition Framework for High-Risk Automated Systems
items.dek: Framework for decomposing which actor coalitions can trigger protected state transitions in distributed high-risk systems.
items.unproven: tested only on protocol models and illustrative cases, not on production authorization architectures the reader maintains

items.title: How to compromise your system with a job interview
items.dek: Social engineering via job interview process used to extract credentials and deploy backdoors; techniques applicable to threat modeling.
items.unproven: whether the attack method described is novel or a systematization of known social-engineering patterns

items.title: Counterexamples to the fractional coloring conjecture for triply efficient shadow tomography
items.dek: Counterexamples disprove fractional coloring conjecture for Pauli shadow tomography; theoretical quantum information with no security practice impact.
items.unproven: applicability to deployed quantum systems; relevance to cryptographic or application security workflows

items.title: Squeezed- and coherent-state quantum key distribution over a deployed hybrid fibre-free-space channel
items.authors: Dnan A. E. Hajomer et al.
items.dek: Continuous-variable QKD over deployed hybrid fibre-free-space links demonstrates adaptive post-processing; early-stage, no evidence of adoption in financial infrastructure.
items.unproven: real-world deployment beyond testbed; integration with production key management; resistance to side-channel attacks in operational settings

items.title: EchoCoT: Extracting Hidden Chain-of-Thought from Large Reasoning Models
items.dek: EchoCoT extracts hidden chain-of-thought traces from frontier reasoning models via API fidelity signals, achieving 66% near-verbatim extraction on open-source models.
items.unproven: Does not establish extraction success rates for frontier models with sufficient detail, or defense mechanisms deployed by providers; lab conditions do not confirm real-world extraction difficulty.

items.title: COPA: Continual Preference Optimization for Adaptive Prompt Injection Defense
items.dek: COPA applies continual preference optimization to prompt injection defense, using margin-weighted replay to retain robustness against prior attacks while adapting to new ones.
items.unproven: Does not establish scalability beyond synthetic attack distributions, absence of gradient inversion leakage, or deployment without retraining cost; test attacks are researcher-designed, not adversary-evolved.

items.title: Tracking the Trend in How Speech Synthesizers Deceive People
items.dek: Human detection of synthetic speech from 2024 synthesizers (ElevenLabs) drops to 48% F1; partial spoofs achieve 9% accuracy and 77% false negatives.
items.unproven: Does not establish whether listener training or segmental detection improves these metrics; sample of 82 IT professionals does not represent general population or audio forensic practitioners.
